minor.issue: App sets Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400 correctly (verified at origin http://localhost:8001), but the preview ingress rewrites it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' on the public URL. Environment-level, not an app bug; browsers will not cache these images in preview. No action needed unless prod ingress does the same.

critical_code_review_comments: upload_brand_image / upload_banner_image build image_url from os.environ['BACKEND_PUBLIC_URL'] with a '' default — if that var is ever missing the DB gets a relative URL like '/api/uploaded-image/...'. Consider failing fast or storing a relative path and resolving at read time.
server.py is 9520 lines — well past the 700-line guideline; admin brand/banner/asset routes are a natural module to split out.

serve_uploaded_image is public and unbounded: every request is a network round-trip to Emergent Object Storage. Consider a small in-process LRU/TTL cache since the ingress strips Cache-Control in preview.
